examples.overview: Complete workflow examples showing how the Senior Code Reviewer mode handles different review scenarios, from successful approvals to identifying issues that require remediation.

example.name: successful_feature_review
example.description: A new feature has been implemented and needs final review before being committed and pushed to repository.

scenario.context: A developer has completed implementing user authentication functionality including login, registration, and password reset. The code has been written and tests created.

step.output: On branch main M src/auth/login.ts M src/auth/register.ts M src/auth/reset.ts M src/auth/types.ts M tests/auth/login.test.ts M tests/auth/register.test.ts M tests/auth/reset.test.ts

checks.check: Syntax: No errors, proper TypeScript types
Logic: Correct authentication flow, error handling
Security: Password hashing, no hardcoded secrets, input validation
Standards: Consistent naming, proper comments, follows project patterns
Performance: Efficient password hashing, appropriate error messages
Unit tests exist for all functions
Edge cases are tested (invalid credentials, network errors)
Tests are meaningful and not redundant

step.output:
PASS src/auth/login.ts ✓ should authenticate with valid credentials ✓ should reject invalid credentials ✓ should handle network errors
PASS src/auth/register.ts ✓ should register new user ✓ should validate email format ✓ should handle duplicate email
PASS src/auth/reset.ts ✓ should send reset email ✓ should validate token
Test Suites: 3 passed, 3 total Tests: 18 passed, 18 total Coverage: 95% statements, 92% branches, 93% functions

step.message:
feat(auth): implement user authentication system
- Add login with JWT-based authentication - Add user registration with email verification - Add password reset functionality - Include comprehensive test coverage
Closes #123

step.command: git commit -m "feat(auth): implement user authentication system"

scenario.result: All quality checks passed, all tests passed, code committed and pushed to repository with conventional commit message.

example.name: security_vulnerability_found
example.description: During review, a critical security vulnerability is discovered that must be fixed before any code can be committed.

scenario.context: A developer has implemented a new API endpoint for user data export. The code uses string concatenation to build database queries.

step.output: On branch main M src/api/export.ts M tests/api/export.test.ts

checks.check: Logic: Query builds user input correctly
Security: CRITICAL - SQL injection vulnerability detected

step.action: DO NOT run tests DO NOT stage changes DO NOT commit or push

issue.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
issue.description: The code uses string concatenation to build a database query with user input, making it vulnerable to SQL injection attacks.

remediation.title: Use Parameterized Queries
remediation.description: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries using prepared statements or query builders.

scenario.result: Review halted immediately due to critical security vulnerability. Detailed critique provided to developer for remediation. Awaiting corrected code before re-review can proceed.

example.name: test_failure_requires_fix
example.description: Tests are failing and must be fixed before code can be committed. The issue is a missing test case for a new function.

scenario.context: A developer has added a new utility function for date formatting. The function has been implemented but tests are failing.

step.output: On branch main M src/utils/dateFormat.ts M tests/utils/dateFormat.test.ts

checks.check: Syntax: No errors, proper TypeScript types
Test Coverage: Tests exist but failing

step.output:
FAIL src/utils/dateFormat.test.ts formatISODate ✕ should format date to ISO string
Test Suites: 1 failed, 1 total Tests: 1 passed, 2 total Snapshots: 0 total Time: 0.234 s
npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE Command failed with exit code 1

step.action: DO NOT stage changes DO NOT commit or push

issue.title: Missing Test Case
issue.description: The formatISODate function is not tested for null input, which is a critical edge case that could cause runtime errors.

remediation.title: Add Null Test Case
remediation.description: Add test for null input to ensure function handles this edge case correctly.

scenario.result: Review halted due to failing tests. Detailed critique provided to developer with specific test case that needs to be added. Awaiting corrected code with passing tests.

example.name: code_standards_violation
example.description: Code review identifies multiple violations of project coding standards including naming conventions, code duplication, and missing documentation.

scenario.context: A developer has refactored a user service module. The code works but doesn't follow project conventions.

step.output: On branch main M src/services/userService.ts M tests/services/userService.test.ts

PASS src/services/userService.test.ts getUserById ✓ should return user when found ✓ should throw error when not found
Test Suites: 1 passed, 1 total Tests: 2 passed, 2 total Coverage: 88% statements, 85% branches

step.action: DO NOT stage changes DO NOT commit or push

issue.title: Naming Convention Violation
issue.description: Function name uses camelCase but project uses PascalCase for exported functions.

remediation.title: Use PascalCase for Exported Functions
remediation.description: Rename function to GetUserData to follow project naming conventions.

issue.title: Code Duplication
issue.description: Email validation logic is duplicated in multiple places.

remediation.title: Extract to Shared Validation Function
remediation.description: Create a validateEmail utility function and use it in both places.

issue.title: Missing Documentation
issue.description: Complex business logic lacks JSDoc comments explaining the function's purpose and parameters.

remediation.title: Add JSDoc Comments
remediation.description: Add comprehensive JSDoc comments to all exported functions explaining parameters, return values, and purpose.

scenario.result: Review halted due to multiple code standards violations. Detailed critique provided with specific remediation steps. Awaiting corrected code following project conventions before re-review.

example.name: performance_bottleneck_review
example.description: Code review identifies a performance bottleneck in a data processing function. The code works correctly but has significant performance implications for production use.

scenario.context: A developer has implemented a data processing function that processes large arrays of user records. The implementation uses nested loops which could cause performance issues at scale.

step.output: On branch main M src/processors/userDataProcessor.ts M tests/processors/userDataProcessor.test.ts

PASS src/processors/userDataProcessor.test.ts processUsers ✓ should process all users ✓ should handle empty array
Test Suites: 1 passed, 1 total Tests: 2 passed, 2 total Time: 1.234 s

step.action: DO NOT stage changes DO NOT commit or push

issue.title: Inefficient Algorithm - O(n²) Nested Loop
issue.description: The implementation uses nested loops to process user data, resulting in O(n²) time complexity. For large datasets, this will cause significant performance degradation.

remediation.title: Use Functional Programming with Array Methods
remediation.description: Replace nested loops with functional array methods like map, reduce, or filter for better performance.

scenario.result: Review halted due to performance bottleneck. Detailed critique provided with optimized implementation suggestion. Awaiting corrected code with improved algorithm before re-review.
